label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is HTML-escaped user input via HtmlUtils.htmlEscape(param) assigned to bar. Although param originates from request.getHeader(), the value is sanitized before any output. All response.getWriter().println() calls output only user (constructed from SafeBystander + class name substring) and rememberMeKey (from SecureRandom), neither containing raw user input. The XSS vulnerability does not materialize on the executed path.
